ios.desc:
Nearly every iPhone has more than one lens on the back, so why not use them? With Photosynthesis, you can use 100% of your camera to bring your memories into sharper focus.

When you take a photo, Photosynthesis fires two lenses at once, then combines the results into one extraordinary photo, delivering real optical detail with no generative AI. The app matches the alignment and color of each lens to create a single cohesive image.

TAKE BETTER PHOTOS ON NEARLY EVERY IPHONE

Photosynthesis delivers the clearest view of your subject without losing the atmosphere, dramatically improving image quality whether you're taking a long-distance shot, or your subject is only an arm's length away.

For 'Pro' iPhones with a zoom lens (3 lenses on the back), Photosynthesis pairs the standard 1x lens with the telephoto zoom to give an amazing upgrade in subject detail, whether that's a singer on stage, a landmark, or the face of a loved one.

Every iPhone with 2+ rear lenses can pair the standard 1x lens with the ultra wide 0.5x lens to add wider context without compromising on detail, perfect for capturing the atmosphere of a live event or a group shot.

iPhones with 3 lenses can also take photos that combine all 3 lenses at once (feature currently in beta).

POWERFUL CAPTURE SETTINGS

As well as flash and timer controls, you can switch lens pairing and control capture mode from the minimalist capture screen.
• SPEED mode captures multiple images at the same instant.
• QUALITY mode captures multiple images at once, then takes another photo from each lens separately. The final photo is then built to give the most detail possible.
• Both modes also work in low light with Photosynthesis's Night mode.

There is also an optional grid and level overlaid on the viewfinder.

A CUSTOM EDITOR BUILT FOR TWO-LENS PHOTOS

The in-app editor provides everything you would expect, including:
• Filters pre-tuned for a variety of different looks
• Manual adjustments, which you can save to make your own filters
• Crop, rotate, flip and straighten your images
• Non-destructive editing - your original is never overwritten

The editor also contains powerful features designed for the unique two-lens photos:
• Align: tweak the relative alignment of the lenses by hand
• Edit: add a filter or manual adjustments to each lens separately
• Reveal: 'paint' over any visual artifacts to reveal the wider lens
